name: Fasttoggle
description: Adds one-click AJAX toggle links on content and comment listings to flip node published/promoted/sticky status and comment published status without opening the edit form.
project_description: Fasttoggle speeds up common content-administration tasks by adding one-click toggle links next to node and comment operations. In version 4.1.x it toggles three node properties (published status, promoted-to-front-page, sticky-at-top-of-lists) and the published status of comments. Each toggle is enabled per bundle: a 'Fasttoggle' details group is added to every content-type edit form (checkboxes for status/promote/sticky) and every comment-type edit form (a status checkbox), stored as `fasttoggle` third-party settings on the node.type / comment.type config entities. When enabled for a bundle, the module's link-alter hooks add the toggle links to that entity's operation links for users holding the 'use fasttoggle' permission. Clicking a link calls the `fasttoggle.toggle` route (`/fasttoggle/{entity_type}/{entity_id}/{action}`, handled by FasttoggleController::toggle) which flips the value and returns an AJAX ReplaceCommand that swaps the link label in place. A single site settings form (route `fasttoggle.settings`, permission 'administer fasttoggle') chooses the link label style: 0 = status labels reflecting the current state (e.g. 'Published'), 1 = action labels showing what a click does (e.g. 'Unpublish'), default 1. The module has no external dependencies, no Drush commands, and provides config schema for its settings object and the per-bundle third-party settings.
